candidates.excerpt: BRS working president KT Rama Rao extended Rs 10 lakh in financial assistance to the family of Telangana movement fighter Iduru Janardhan, who died after struggling with poverty. Fixed deposits were arranged for his three daughters, alongside immediate support for the family.

candidates.title: KTR says Telangana district reorganisation brought governance closer to people
candidates.excerpt: BRS working president KT Rama Rao said the reorganisation of Telangana’s districts under the BRS government brought governance closer to people. Marking a decade since the reorganisation, he cited improved access to district headquarters, public services and welfare delivery.

candidates.title: Rotary Club of Hyderabad Deccan takes the wheel for cancer pathology and diagnostics
candidates.excerpt: The Rotary Club of Hyderabad Deccan held the third edition of its annual Hyderabad Shaan-e-Deccan TSD car rally to raise funds for cancer detection equipment. Actor Sai Durgha Tej flagged off the event, which featured seven award categories
